subject: general
question:
Select the number from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

7, 13, 25, 43, ? , 97
solution:
**The pattern followed here is : Consecutive multiple of (6) is added.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d42f452237a7a53d58c79b270dcd875a14048674ba90c5ab4b6ad0849245163.png] 

Hence, **"67"** is the correct answer.
